target: Choose an existing native low-precision dense attention baseline that can be run without modifying the installed Torch/CUDA environment on RTX4090.
known_environment: Torch2.6.0+cu124/Triton3.2.0/nvcc12.4/no Sage package. FA2 exists from past experiments; exact active package path/version to inspect before proposing run.
motivation: Self-attention is measured large in one stored video profile; actual end-to-end gain of existing native low-precision backend and its preparation fraction are not measured. Do not invent a deployment latency requirement.
allow: Read existing/pinned public source, at most1repo and6 additional source files
Prepare isolated source-only import adapter or exact minimal supported build recipe with no install/compile execution
Pure scalar or small synthetic CPU validation without model/data tensor loads
forbid: pip/package install or global toolchain update
model/tensor pickle load or model acquisition
claim Sage1 and Sage2++ are interchangeable strong baselines
candidate_runtime_grid_if_feasible: Prospective synthetic B1/H12/D128,Q4680,K4680/18720/32760/56160 rectangular noncausal shapes; no video quality/control claim. Whole API/prepared-input same-format identity and FA2 descriptive cost only. Runtime bounds and gates require separate reviewed spec.
priority: Prefer official pure-Triton existing attention path if it avoids a CUDA rebuild; if that is an older/weaker baseline say so and do not use it to establish SOTA novelty. If viable native Sage2 can compile under current12.4, a build recipe may be returned but do not execute build.
writer: Root Codex direct; native quota limit not retried; actual retained Opus independently reviews feasibility/limits before any execution.
